dimensions.label: Stage & hiring pressure
dimensions.description: Series A-C expanding eng team = 5; pre-revenue seed no eng org = 1; idea stage = 0

dimensions.label: Team composition
dimensions.description: Strong eng founders + visible full-stack/infra/AI people = 5; non-technical team building tech = 0

dimensions.label: Operating model
dimensions.description: Own product, complex data, B2B, productization ambition = 5; prompt studio / content mill = 0

dimensions.label: Culture & work style
dimensions.description: Builder culture, eng ownership, young but organized = 5; exploitative or chaotic = 0

dimensions.label: Technical relevance
dimensions.description: AI/data systems, agent infra, retrieval, eval, runtime = 5; demo/prompt tuning only = 1; no tech depth = 0

dimensions.label: Coding ownership
dimensions.description: Mostly coding + system design with standards = 5; title is engineer but actually consultant = 0

dimensions.label: Visa & location feasibility
dimensions.description: UK base, sponsors, no clearance limits = 5; no sponsor no path = 0 (hard blocker)

dimensions.label: Interview signal
dimensions.description: Coding + system design + case study = 5; only behavioral/consulting = 1; no info = 3
